business_summary: CTG Hongkong and Macao Culture and Tourism Holding Limited provides tourism services in Hong Kong, Macao, and the Mainland China. It offers passenger transport, hotel operations, travel documents, and property investment. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Central, Hong Kong. CTG Hongkong and Macao Culture and Tourism Holding Limited operates as a subsidiary of China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Limited.
business_summary_ko: CTG Hongkong and Macao Culture and Tourism Holding Limited는 홍콩, 마카오 및 중국 본토에서 관광 서비스를 제공합니다. 여객 운송, 호텔 운영, 여행 서류 및 부동산 투자를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 2025년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 센트럴에 본사를 두고 있습니다. CTG Hongkong과 Macao Culture and Tourism Holding Limited는 China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
